name: onevideo
description: Make a polished short video from a prompt. Renders on your computer with free tools: motion, original music, optional voiceover and captions.
long_description: OneVideo turns a prompt into a finished MP4: product launches, app demos, explainers, ads and reels. Claude writes the story, animates it in a headless browser, composes an original soundtrack and renders it with FFmpeg. Everything runs on your computer. No paid services, no watermark. Needs Python 3.9+ and FFmpeg; Claude can install the Python parts for you.
